hero.pill: Ben Nguyen · Product & Digital Designer, Auckland
hero.title: I design websites and apps that are easy to use, and the brands behind them.
hero.lead: I have more than ten years of experience across agency and independent work, designing marketing websites, customer portals, brand identities and apps. I am open to a full-time or contract role, and I also take on freelance projects.

services.heading: There are four ways we can work together.

items.title: Full-time or contract role
items.body: I am looking for a product, UI/UX or digital design role, permanent or contract. I live in Auckland and am happy to work hybrid or on site.
list: Design from discovery and information architecture through to UI, prototypes, handover and QA
Figma design systems with reusable components and notes for developers
Websites, customer portals, dashboards and mobile apps
Close work with project managers, business analysts, developers and marketing
items.start: Get in touch and I will send you my CV.

items.title: Projects
items.body: Websites, apps and brand identities, from the first brief through to launch. I start with the people who will use it and how the content is organised, before any visual design.
list: Visual design for desktop and mobile
Developer handover and a check of the build before launch
items.start: A free call to talk through what you need, then a fixed quote.

items.title: Monthly design
items.body: For small teams who need a designer most weeks, but not forty hours of one. You get a set number of hours each month for whatever comes up, from someone who already knows your brand.
list: Email newsletters, social posts and ads
Brochures, flyers and other print work
Small changes to an existing app or portal
items.start: A free call to agree the hours and how requests come through.

items.title: Small jobs
items.body: One landing page, an ad set, a brochure, a book cover or a pack design, with a clear brief and a quick turnaround.
list: Send the brief and any brand files you have
Agree a fixed price before any work starts
Receive files ready for print or the web
items.start: Email the brief, or book a free call if it needs talking through.

about.heading: Hi, I'm Ben.
paragraphs: I am a product and digital designer with more than ten years of experience. Six of those years were at Avidly, an APAC HubSpot partner, where I started as a digital designer and spent the last four years leading design on websites, customer portals and web apps for clients across New Zealand and Australia.

Since July 2025 I have worked for myself. I design for small businesses, have contracted with Zib Digital on client websites, and design and ship my own iOS apps, including SoundLax. Taking an app from the first sketch to the App Store changed how I work: I now think about a product from the start through to release, not only the screens.
I came up building sites in HTML and CSS, so I understand how a design gets built. On a team, I see my role as a bridge between marketing, business analysts, project managers and developers.

cta.heading: Hiring, or have a project in mind?
cta.body: Tell me about the role or what you are working on. The first call is free, and I will give you a straight answer on whether I am the right fit.

footer.blurb: Bentoji is the design practice of Ben Nguyen, a product and digital designer in Auckland working on websites, apps and brands.
